commits_data.title: Add override to overridden C++ methods.
commits_data.message:
Add override to overridden C++ methods.

Add override to overridden C++ methods to communicate
which methods are overridden and ensure signature matches.

Many found and fixed with:
run-clang-tidy -checks='modernize-use-override' -fix -p build/

Remainder found by adding "-Wsuggest-override" to
WIRESHARK_CXX_ONLY_FLAGS.

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude Sonnet 4.6)
